headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 22, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Joey Cantillo earning the win after 5.2 innings of work. Dillon Dingler led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other action, the Pittsburgh Pirates took down the St. Louis Cardinals 6-2, led by Braxton Ashcraft's 7.0 innings of work, and the New York Mets edged out the Washington Nationals 2-1.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Chicago Cubs right fielder Matt Shaw due to mid-back tightness, St. Louis Cardinals left fielder Nathan Church with a left shoulder strain, and Atlanta Braves pitcher Hurston Waldrep after undergoing right elbow surgery.

The Cincinnati Reds have bolstered their pitching staff with the acquisition of right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley in a trade with the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Tigers 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Joey Cantillo earning the win after 5.2 innings of work. Dillon Dingler led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Cardinals 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Braxton Ashcraft leading the way on the mound. Ashcraft pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Nationals in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets edged out the Washington Nationals with a final score of 2-1, securing their win. David Peterson earned the win for the Mets, while Devin Williams secured the save.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Marlins in Dominant 9-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves took down the Miami Marlins 9-3, behind a standout performance from Michael Harris II, who hit two home runs and drove in three runs. Spencer Strider earned the win, pitching 6.1 innings with 9 strikeouts and 3 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Cubs' Matt Shaw Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Chicago Cubs right fielder Matt Shaw has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to mid-back tightness, with the move retroactive to May 20, 2026.

top_news.title: **Reds Acquire RHP Zach McCambley in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley in a trade. McCambley joins the Reds after being dealt from the Miami Marlins.
